body:
Jinshu 080's date repair correctly identified two existing posthumous claims as retrospective reception, but the repair boundary rejected adding that classification. Permit only adding `receptionType: "retrospective"` to an existing dated non-life claim while preserving its subject, predicate, certainty, evidence and all other non-date content. Preserve that classification when reconstructing the final repair delta. Also align worker precision guidance with the existing production vocabulary (`year`/`circa`); finer calendar detail stays in `sourceDate`.

The candidate still requires a fresh independent source/date audit before publication. Arbitrary fact changes, classification withdrawal, invalid labels and replacements of undated non-temporal claims remain rejected.

Validation: 268 offline tests pass, including final-delta replay and refusal to publish after a rejected independent re-audit. Independent code review approved the exact final revision, including the precision guidance. All remaining native messages, including the retained-author correction, pass the 56 KiB admission guard. This does not approve or publish Jinshu 080.
